        # Format: "10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000"
        # We want to compare "10/Oct/2023:13:55:36" with our start/end times
        time_part = time_str.split(' ')[0]  # This gets "10/Oct/2023:13:55:36"

        # Parse the log time format

        date_part, time_part = time_part.split(':')
        day, month_str, year = date_part.split('/')
